_instructions: Copy this file (e.g. to config.json), fill in your own values, and point Jason at the copy. Never edit this template directly.

site._instructions: Your primary site's repo and any secondary properties Jason audits.

standards._instructions: Where your filled-in site standards live. See Plugins/ops-team-open/customization/my-site-standards.md for the format this repo already ships.
standards.site_standards_path: [PATH TO YOUR FILLED-IN my-site-standards.md OR EQUIVALENT]

page_types._instructions: How content-qa tells a conversion page from a utility page. Use path patterns, not full URLs.

routing._instructions: What counts as a rule-based fix (safe to auto-PR) vs a judgment call (flag to owner). Adjust to your own risk tolerance.
rule_based: [e.g. removing a redirect for a source that never existed]
judgment_call: [e.g. redirect source file still exists -- possible conflict]

thresholds._instructions: Tunable pass/fail bars used by site-audit.

notifications.webhook_url_env: [NAME OF YOUR ENV VAR -- never paste the URL itself here]

scheduling._instructions: Suggested cadence -- see hooks/hook-map.md for the full trigger table.
